title: A battler dragged in by Roar/Whirlwind before it acts does NOT act that turn: Cmd_switchineffects writes B_ACTION_CANCEL_PARTNER (== B_ACTION_FINISHED, 12) into its gActionsByTurnOrder slot, so neither the banked move nor its own slot move runs and no GetMoveTarget draw happens
scenario: Player RHYHORN (Roar [TM05] / Horn Attack / Stomp / Tail Whip, speed 45) picks slot 0 ROAR every turn it is out; bench ZIGZAGOON (Tackle/Growl/Tail Whip/Headbutt) and POOCHYENA (Tackle/Howl/Sand-Attack/Bite) pick slot 0 TACKLE. Opponent PIDGEOT (Whirlwind x4, Jolly, 255 Speed EVs) is faster, so both -6 moves resolve Pidgeot first: Whirlwind drags the player's active battler out before it acts. Turn 1 is the census-811 shape (banked ROAR 46, dragged-in ZIGZAGOON slot 0 = TACKLE 33); later turns repeat it with every bench mon, including RHYHORN dragged back in after a TACKLE was banked.

sourceUnderTest.neverReached: reference/pokeemerald/src/battle_util.c:78-146 HandleAction_UseMove (absentBattlerFlags :85, Encore arms :111-128, :130-134 GetMoveTarget arm) is never entered for the dragged-in battler that turn
sourceUnderTest.exception: Not exercised here: when the dragged-in mon's switch-in ability fires (e.g. Drizzle), AbilityBattleEffects pushes the cursor without advancing it (the :5296 advance is inside the cancel arm), so switchineffects re-runs after the ability script and the cancel lands on that second pass. Intimidate / Trace return 0 from AbilityBattleEffects and take the cancel arm directly (port note battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.ts:1284-1290).

portSitesAtHead.cancelWriteMissing: src/engine/battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.ts:1325-1338 ports the `if (!Ability && !Item)` body (clears SIDE_STATUS_SPIKES_DAMAGED, advances) but never writes actionsByTurnOrder[i] = B_ACTION_CANCEL_PARTNER for the switched-in battler's turn-order slot (source :5270-5274)
portSitesAtHead.secondActionGate: src/engine/factoryBattleScriptFullTurnDecision.ts:2986 skips action 2 only when actionsByTurnOrder[1] === B_ACTION_TRY_FINISH (Pursuit); 12 (B_ACTION_FINISHED / CANCEL_PARTNER) is not checked, so the dragged-in battler runs its own action
portSitesAtHead.whatThePortRuns: after rng146 F3 the port's action 2 takes the :130-134 arm for the dragged-in mon (slot move != banked move): GetMoveTarget + the slot move's full hit chain -- the census-811 'GLOOM used MOONLIGHT' route. Before F3 it ran the banked ROAR. The ROM runs neither.

fixShape: (1) battleScriptSwitchinOpcode.ts, in the :1325-1338 cancel body: for every turn-order slot i with battlerByTurnOrder[i] === battler write actionsByTurnOrder[i] = 12 (B_ACTION_CANCEL_PARTNER; source :5270-5274). (2) factoryBattleScriptFullTurnDecision.ts:2986: skip action 2 when actionsByTurnOrder[1] is B_ACTION_TRY_FINISH (11) OR B_ACTION_FINISHED (12) -- source HandleAction_ActionFinished (battle_util.c:658-663) dispatches the slot's value, and 12 is HandleAction_ActionFinished again, which ends the turn. No new draw sites; the post-fix sequence is the ROM's.
